summary: Mobile parity retest for (1) dismissible Verify-email banner with 24h AsyncStorage suppression and (2) Profile Account card. All three requested flows pass on Expo web preview @ 390x844 as bibi@test.com.
critical_code_review_comments: EmailVerifyBanner.tsx uses in-memory `_cache` (module-scoped) with 45s TTL and reads AsyncStorage on mount — behaviour is correct. Consider surfacing dismiss to Sentry/analytics later.
profile-edit uses `user.created_at` via `(user as any)` — consider typing on the User model for maintainability.
